title: ok, but not working
text: ok, but not working. This was purchased for our small fridge to store drinks in. after measuring 3x's to see which size I needed, I bought this one because I thought it would fit & I expected to be able to lay something on top. Well, sadly, it does not fit well enough to actually close the door securely. Very disappointed!
